AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA

&

Monday, April 6, 2015
06:30 p.m.
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING 5:30 P.M.:
CALL TO ORDER: Administrative Conference Room 106
I.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS:
II.
CLOSED SESSION:
a.
Conference with Labor Negotiator per Government Code Section 54957.6 - Agency Representative: Jim Sadro, City Manager; Employee Organizations: Police Sworn Employees, Police Civilian Employees, La Habra Municipal Employees Association, General Services Employees, Professional Employees, and Management and Executive Management Groups.
b.
Conference with Real Property Negotiator per Government Code Section 54956.8 - Property: 100-120 East La Habra Boulevard and 201 East La Habra Boulevard; City Negotiator: Jim Sadro, City Manager: Negotiating Parties: Ryan Aeh, City Ventures; Under Negotiation: Development Agreement.
III.
ADJOURNMENT:
Except as otherwise provided by law, no action shall be taken on any item not appearing in the foregoing agenda. A copy of the full agenda packet is available for public review at the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours or on the City's webpage at http://www.lahabraca.gov/.
Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the City Council/Authority/Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at 110 East La Habra Boulevard, La Habra, during normal business hours
In accordance with the Federal Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, should you require a disability-related modification or accommodation, including auxiliary aids or services to participate in the meeting due to a disability, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (562) 383-4030.

REGULAR MEETING 6:30 P.M.:
CALL TO ORDER: Council Chambers
INVOCATION: City Attorney Jones
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Councilmember Beamish
ROLL CALL:
CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT:
I.
PROCLAMATIONS/PRESENTATIONS:
a.
Proclaim Thursday, May 7, 2015, as a day set apart for the Annual Mayor's Prayer Breakfast in recognition of the National Day of Prayer.
Ia CC Mayor's Prayer Brkfst proc
b.
Proclaim the week of April 12 - 18, 2015, as National Public Safety Telecommunications Week in the City of La Habra.
Ib PD Proc Natl Public Safety Tel Week2015
c.
Proclaim the week of April 12 - 18, 2015, as National Animal Control Officer Appreciation Week in the City of La Habra.
Ic PD Proc Natl Animal Control Officer2015
d.
Proclaim April 18, 2015, as Earth Day/Arbor Day in the City of La Habra.
Id PW Proc Earth Arbor Day
II.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
This is the time for the public to address any item of City Council/Authority/Agency business NOT appearing on this Agenda. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each. The total time period for public comment is 30 minutes.
(Note: Per Government Code Section 54954.3(a), the City Council/Authority/Agency cannot take action or express a consensus of approval or disapproval on any public comments regarding matters which do not appear on the printed agenda.)
III.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
All matters on Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a Councilmember/Director or member of the audience requests separate action or removal of an item. Removed items will be considered following the Consent Calendar portion of this agenda. Members of the audience will have the opportunity to address Authority on removed items at that time. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
A.
PROPOSED ITEMS:
1.
PROCEDURAL WAIVER: Waive reading in full of resolutions and ordinances and approval and adoption of same by reading title only.
2.
Approve City Council Minutes of:
a.
March 16, 2015
III2a CC 20150316m cc
b.
March 23, 2015
III2b CC 20150323m cc
3.
Receive and file Planning Commission Minutes of:
a.
February 9, 2015
III3a CD PC Min 2'9'15
b.
February 23, 2015
III3b CD PC Min 2'23'15
4.
Authorize City Manager to execute License Agreement with Southern California Edison Company for the use of the north parking lot at Esteli Park from May 1, 2015 through April 30, 2020.
III4 CS SCE License agrmt
5.
Authorize City Manager to execute contract extension with Diversified Thermal Services (DTS) in the amount of $24,754 for the 12 month period beginning April 1, 2015 through March 31, 2016 for annual maintenance and upkeep of HVAC equipment at City facilities.
III5 CS HVAC 2015 agrmt
6.
WARRANTS: Approve Nos. 00100666 through 00100958 totaling $1,802,353.54.
III6 FAS Warrants 20150406
7.
Approve staff's recommendation regarding a request for "No Stopping" Restrictions at 275-299 South Monte Vista Street; and
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. ______ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA PROHIBITING STOPPING, STANDING AND PARKING AT ALL TIMES ON MONTE VISTA STREET SOUTH OF LA HABRA BOULEVARD.
III7 PW 275-299 S Monte Vista
8.
Approve and authorize City Manager to enter into agreement with National Data & Surveying Services of Beverly Hills in the amount of $115,559 to provide professional engineering services for the Citywide Traffic Control Devices Inventory and Sign Retro-Reflectivity Analysis Project; and authorize staff to issue a purchase order in the amount of $127,115 that includes a 10% Contingency.
III8 PW Citywide TCDI NDS
9.
Approve staff's recommendation regarding a request for "No Stopping" restrictions on Coachwood Street at Wedgewood Lane; and
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. ______ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA PROHIBITING STOPPING, STANDING AND PARKING AT ALL TIMES ON COACHWOOD STREET NORTH OF WEDGEWOOD LANE.
III9 PW Coachwood Wedgewood
IV.
CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS REMOVED FOR SEPARATE DISCUSSION:
III.9

a. APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. ______ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA PROHIBITING STOPPING, STANDING AND PARKING AT ALL TIMES ON COACHWOOD STREET NORTH OF WEDGEWOOD LANE.
V.
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
NOTE: If a challenge is made by any party in court from actions arising out of a public hearing, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice or in written correspondence delivered at the public hearing or prior thereto.
1.
Duly noticed public hearing to consider and certify Environmental Impact Report 15-01 (SCH 2014101029) for 201 East La Habra Boulevard and 200 North Euclid Street and 100, 110 and 120 East La Habra Boulevard and 107 East First Avenue subject to the Findings of Fact and the Mitigation Monitoring Plan for the construction of up to 110 residential units.
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. _______ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA CERTIFYING THE ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT (EIR #15-01), (SCH 2014101029) FOR 201 EAST LA HABRA BOULEVARD AND 200 NORTH EUCLID STREET, AND 100, 110 AND 120 EAST LA HABRA BOULEVARD, AND 107 EAST FIRST AVENUE SUBJECT TO THE MITIGATION MONITORING AND REPORTING PROGRAM AND STATEMENT OF FINDINGS OF FACT, ATTACHED HERETO AS EXHIBITS "A" AND "B".
V1 CD City Ventures EIR
V1 CD City Ventures EIR Att2
VI.
CONSIDERATION ITEMS: None at this time.
Any member of the audience may request to address the City Council/Authority/Agency on any Consideration Item, prior to the City Council/Authority/Agency taking a final vote on the Item. The Mayor will invite interested persons to come forward to the podium and speak as each Item is called. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
